name: Baselga di Piné (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Baselga di Piné (a pine tree above waves on light blue) within branches and the inscription Comune di Baselga di Piné in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Baselga di Piné, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Baselga di Piné arms — pine tree above waves on light blue, crowned, within branches
inscription Comune di Baselga di Piné beneath the arms
